rows.grounds: instrumental of a compound meaning a thread of the same color; used as the measuring implement
optative verb expressing a ritual instruction to measure the garland
instrumental of a compound referring to the heart-seed mantra employed in the act

items.question: What instrument and mantra are prescribed for measuring the prepared garland?
premises: The garland requires precise measurement in the ritual procedure.
A thread of equal color serves as the measuring instrument.
The heart-seed mantra accompanies the act of measuring.
items.inference: The garland should be measured with a same-colored thread while employing the heart-seed mantra.
uncertainties: The exact identity of the hṛdayāṇu mantra is not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: One should measure it with a thread of the same color, using the heart-seed mantra.
